item.title: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond Box Office Collections 2nd Friday: Records 12 percent drop, enters 2nd weekend with Rs 1.75 crore
item.description: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond, directed by Kamakhya Narayan Singh, collected Rs. 1.75 crore on its second Friday. The movie saw a 12 per cent drop from the previous day. Allied to its Rs. 20.15 crore of the first week, The Kerala Story 2 now stands at Rs. 21.90 crore nett at the Indian box office in its 8 days of theatrical run. Starring Ulka Gupta, Aishwarya Ojha, Aditi Bhatia and others in the lead roles, the movie is expected to cross the Rs. 25 crore mark by the end of its second weekend.

item.description: Assi, directed by Anubhav Sinha and starring Taapsee Pannu in the lead role, entered its third weekend by collecting Rs. 10 lakh on Friday. The movie recorded a drop of 33 per cent from the previous day. The dip from last Friday is about 75 per cent. That said, the movie has almost exhausted its entire theatrical run.
